problem: A 21-word question with two "if" clauses around the money amounts, hard to follow whether read or heard.

fix.prompt: You have [[m:15]]. A toy costs [[m:12]]. How would you check if you have enough money?

evidence: Rule 1 (one idea per sentence; Inclusion Europe Easy-to-Read) and Gathercole & Alloway (2008). The money tokens are kept.

es.prompt: Tienes [[m:15]]. Un juguete cuesta [[m:12]]. ¿Cómo comprobarías si tienes suficiente dinero?

fr.prompt: Tu as [[m:15]]. Un jouet coûte [[m:12]]. Comment vérifierais-tu si tu as assez d'argent ?

pt.prompt: Você tem [[m:15]]. Um brinquedo custa [[m:12]]. Como você verificaria se tem dinheiro suficiente?

it.prompt: Hai [[m:15]]. Un giocattolo costa [[m:12]]. Come controlleresti se hai abbastanza soldi?

nl.prompt: Je hebt [[m:15]]. Een speeltje kost [[m:12]]. Hoe zou je nagaan of je genoeg geld hebt?

ru.prompt: У тебя есть [[m:15]]. Игрушка стоит [[m:12]]. Как бы ты проверил, хватает ли тебе денег?

tr.prompt: Elinde [[m:15]] var. Bir oyuncağın fiyatı [[m:12]]. Paranın yetip yetmediğini nasıl kontrol ederdin?

problem: "3 x 4" uses the letter x, which text-to-speech reads as "ex" now that the card is read aloud, and which means a variable at level 7.

fix.prompt: How would you work out 3 × 4 if you didn't know your times tables yet?

evidence: Notation consistency (× elsewhere in the bank). Each language keeps its own wording with x replaced by ×; those 13 strings are attached, so nothing new is translated.

es.prompt: ¿Cómo resolverías 3 × 4 si todavía no conocieras las tablas de multiplicar?

fr.prompt: Comment calculerais-tu 3 × 4 si tu ne connaissais pas encore tes tables de multiplication ?

pt.prompt: Como você calcularia 3 × 4 se ainda não soubesse a tabuada?

it.prompt: Come faresti a calcolare 3 × 4 se non conoscessi ancora le tabelline?

de.prompt: Wie würdest du 3 × 4 ausrechnen, wenn du dein Einmaleins noch nicht kennst?

nl.prompt: Hoe zou je 3 × 4 uitrekenen als je de tafels nog niet kende?

ru.prompt: Как бы ты решил 3 × 4, если бы ещё не знал таблицу умножения?

tr.prompt: Çarpım tablosunu henüz bilmiyor olsan 3 × 4'ü nasıl çözerdin?

zh.prompt: 如果你还不会乘法口诀,你会怎么算出3×4?

ja.prompt: まだかけ算を覚えていなかったら、3 × 4 はどうやって計算する？

ko.prompt: 구구단을 아직 모른다면 3 × 4를 어떻게 계산할 건가요?

id.prompt: Bagaimana cara kamu mengerjakan 3 × 4 jika belum hafal perkalian?

vi.prompt: Bạn sẽ tính 3 × 4 như thế nào nếu chưa biết bảng cửu chương?

problem: Only the last number counts, so "7" said first and then the retell (or a retell cut short at a pause) is marked wrong.
evidence: Checked with checkAnswer: "seven. Tom had four apples…" is "incorrect". Recognition is not continuous, so it can stop at a pause. 7 never appears in the story, so 7 said anywhere is safe. Apply in rules.js (case MA-SPK-T13/T14: drop number_final).
